interpretation.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue

preconditions.name: salient_events_per_cell_floor
preconditions.description: min over cells of n_salient_events -- the DV is per-event, so a cell below this measured nothing usable
preconditions.control: every cell of every arm; the harm trigger fires abundantly on this hazard-carrying env by construction

preconditions.name: no_reset_control_shows_partial_integration
preconditions.description: min over seeds of straddle_frac(NO_RESET). what_would_answer requires a no-reset control in which partial integration MEASURABLY OCCURS; below this floor there is nothing to compare
preconditions.control: NO_RESET arm -- phase_reset() never executes, so the E3 tick is the bare periodic counter and events land at arbitrary phase

preconditions.name: rate_match_holds
preconditions.description: max over seeds of |e3_rate(RATE_MATCHED)-e3_rate(ALIGNED)|/e3_rate(ALIGNED). C3 only separates PHASE from RATE while the rates are matched
preconditions.control: RATE_MATCHED re-issues every suppressed reset, so its executed count matches ALIGNED's up to end-of-episode truncation

criteria.name: C1_manipulation_check
criteria.description: ALIGNED executes resets and NO_RESET executes none, every seed

criteria.name: C3_rate_matched_straddle_delta
criteria.description: straddle_frac(RATE_MATCHED) - straddle_frac(ALIGNED) >= 0.50 every seed (phase, not rate)

interpretation.combination_rule: PASS iff (P1 AND P2 AND P3) AND C1 AND C2 AND C3. Plain AND. C4 is corroborating and does not gate. C1 is a manipulation check, not a finding.
